reference_title: Standard Practice Manual for Flexible Pavements

sections.title: Government and Military Standards
sections.summary: Appendix A opens with government/military documents grouped under three headings: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) test methods (CRD-C series), Unified Facilities Criteria (companion UFCs on recycling, soil stabilization, and airfield pavement design), and Unified Facilities Guide Specifications (UFGS construction specs for tack/prime coats and airfield asphalt paving).
sections.body: The reference appendix lists, under the heading U.S. ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS, three CRD (Concrete Research Division) test methods from the Handbook for Cement and Concrete: CRD-C649-95 (unit weight, Marshall stability, and flow of bituminous mixtures), CRD-C650-95 (density and percent voids in compacted bituminous paving mixtures), and CRD-C171-94 (percentage of crushed particles in aggregate). Under UNIFIED FACILITIES CRITERIA it lists three companion UFCs: 3-250-07 (Standard Practice for Pavement Recycling), 3-250-11 (Soil Stabilization for Pavements, cited repeatedly elsewhere in this manual for stabilization design/construction detail), and 3-260-02 (Pavement Design for Airfields). Under UNIFIED FACILITIES GUIDE SPECIFICATIONS it lists three UFGS construction specifications: 32 12 13 (Bituminous Tack and Prime Coats), 32 12 15.13 (Asphalt Paving for Airfields), and 32 12 15.16 (Warm Mix Asphalt Airfield Paving). All three groups are DoD/USACE-published documents available at wbdg.org.
key_points: USACE CRD test methods: CRD-C649-95 (Marshall stability/flow), CRD-C650-95 (density/percent voids), CRD-C171-94 (percent crushed particles).
Companion UFCs: 3-250-07 (Pavement Recycling), 3-250-11 (Soil Stabilization for Pavements), 3-260-02 (Pavement Design for Airfields).
UFGS construction specs: 32 12 13 (Tack/Prime Coats), 32 12 15.13 (Asphalt Paving for Airfields), 32 12 15.16 (Warm Mix Asphalt Airfield Paving).
All documents in this group are DoD/USACE-published, available at wbdg.org.
sections.applicability: Consult when locating the DoD/USACE companion criteria, guide specifications, or Corps test methods referenced elsewhere in this manual.

sections.title: Industry and Association Technical Standards
sections.summary: Groups the non-ASTM technical-association references cited by the manual: one Airfield Asphalt Pavement Technology Program (AAPTP) best-practices report, a set of AASHTO material specifications and test methods (binder grading, soil particle size/liquid limit, aggregate abrasion/soundness, Marshall/HMA density and air-voids tests), and five Asphalt Institute manuals/specifications covering surface treatments and asphalt mix design.
sections.body: Under AIRFIELD ASPHALT PAVEMENT TECHNOLOGY PROGRAM, the appendix cites AAPTP 05-01, Airfield Asphalt Pavement Construction Best Practices Manual. Under AMERICAN ASSOCIATION OF STATE HIGHWAY AND TRANSPORTATION OFFICIALS (AASHTO) it lists M320-17-UL (Performance-Graded Asphalt Binder) and R029-15-UL (Grading/Verifying PG Asphalt Binder), plus a run of T-series test methods: T088 (particle size analysis of soils), T089 (liquid limit of soils), T096 (LA abrasion of coarse aggregate), T104 (soundness by sodium/magnesium sulfate), T166 (bulk specific gravity of compacted HMA), T209 (theoretical maximum specific gravity/density of HMA), T210 (aggregate durability index), T245 (Marshall stability/flow), and T269 (percent air voids in compacted asphalt mixtures). Under ASPHALT INSTITUTE it lists ES-11 (Asphalt Surface Treatments Specifications), ES-12 (Asphalt Surface Treatments Construction Techniques), MS-2 (Asphalt Mix Design Methods), MS-14 (Asphalt Cold Mix Manual), and MS-19 (Basic Asphalt Emulsion Manual).
key_points: AAPTP 05-01: Airfield Asphalt Pavement Construction Best Practices Manual.
AASHTO binder specs: M320-17-UL (Performance-Graded Asphalt Binder), R029-15-UL (grading/verifying PG binder).
AASHTO T-series tests cover soil gradation/Atterberg limits (T088/T089), aggregate abrasion/soundness/durability (T096/T104/T210), and compacted HMA density/voids/stability (T166/T209/T245/T269).
Asphalt Institute manuals: ES-11/ES-12 (surface treatments), MS-2 (mix design), MS-14 (cold mix), MS-19 (asphalt emulsions).
sections.applicability: Consult when locating the AAPTP, AASHTO, or Asphalt Institute standard behind a binder grade, soil/aggregate test method, or mix design reference used elsewhere in this manual.

sections.title: ASTM Standards
sections.summary: The largest reference group: roughly sixty ASTM standards spanning aggregate/soil test methods (soundness, sieve analysis, LA abrasion, Atterberg limits, sand equivalent, flat/elongated particles), asphalt binder and mixture test methods (specific gravity/density, viscosity, extraction, air voids, Marshall stability, moisture susceptibility, asphalt content by ignition or nuclear method), binder/emulsion/cutback material specifications (penetration-graded, performance-graded, emulsified, and cutback asphalts by cure rate), and specialized specifications for fly ash, mineral filler, and slurry-seal/micro-surfacing design and sampling practice.
sections.body: The ASTM group (astm.org) is organized as a single long alphanumeric list rather than sub-headed. Representative aggregate/soil methods: C88 (soundness by sodium/magnesium sulfate), C117 (material finer than 75-micrometer/No. 200 sieve), C127/C128 (specific gravity and absorption of coarse/fine aggregate), C131 (LA abrasion), C136 (sieve analysis), C142 (clay lumps and friable particles), D2419 (sand equivalent value), D4318 (Atterberg limits), D4791 (flat and elongated particles), and D448 (aggregate size classification for road/bridge construction). Representative binder/mixture material specifications: C150 (Portland cement), C618 (fly ash/pozzolan), D242 (mineral filler), D946/D3381/D6373 (penetration-graded/viscosity-graded/performance-graded asphalt binder), D977/D2397 (emulsified/cationic emulsified asphalt), D2026/D2027/D2028 (slow/medium/rapid-curing cutback asphalt), and D5727 (emulsified refined coal tar). Representative test methods: D70 (density of semi-solid bituminous materials), D244 (emulsified asphalt test methods/practices), D402 (distillation of cutback asphalt), D2041/D3203 (theoretical maximum specific gravity and percent air voids of bituminous mixtures), D2170/D2171 (asphalt viscosity, kinematic and vacuum capillary), D2172 (quantitative extraction of asphalt binder), D2726 (bulk specific gravity of non-absorptive compacted mixtures), D2995 (bituminous distributor application rate), D3910 (design/testing/construction of slurry seal), D4125/D6307 (asphalt content by nuclear method/ignition method), D4867 (moisture effect on AC paving mixtures), D5148 (centrifuge kerosene equivalent), D5444 (mechanical size analysis of extracted aggregate), D5624 (transverse aggregate spread rate), D6372 (design/testing/construction of micro-surfacing), D6390 (draindown in uncompacted mixtures), and D6927 (Marshall stability and flow). C1252 (uncompacted void content of fine aggregate) and C612 (mineral fiber block/board thermal insulation) and D1139/D1369 (bituminous surface treatment aggregate/quantities) round out the list, along with D979/D3665/D5361 (sampling practices).
key_points: Aggregate/soil test methods: C88/C127/C128/C131/C136/C142 (soundness, specific gravity, LA abrasion, sieve analysis, clay lumps), D2419 (sand equivalent), D4318 (Atterberg limits), D4791 (flat/elongated particles).

Binder/mixture material specs: C150 (Portland cement), C618 (fly ash), D242 (mineral filler), D946/D3381/D6373 (penetration/viscosity/PG-graded binder), D977/D2397 (emulsions), D2026-D2028 (cutbacks by cure rate).

Bituminous mixture test methods: D2041/D3203 (theoretical max specific gravity/air voids), D2170/D2171/D2172 (viscosity/extraction), D2726, D4867 (moisture susceptibility), D6307/D4125 (asphalt content by ignition/nuclear method), D6927 (Marshall stability/flow).
Slurry-seal/micro-surfacing and specialty methods: D3910 (slurry seal design/testing/construction), D5148 (CKE), D6372 (micro-surfacing), D6390 (draindown), D5624 (spread rate).
Sampling practices: D979, D3665, D5361, D2995.
sections.applicability: Consult when locating the specific ASTM test method or material specification cited for an aggregate, binder, or mixture requirement used elsewhere in this manual.

sections.title: Slurry Surfacing and Paving Industry Association Standards
sections.summary: Groups two specialty industry-association reference sets: four International Slurry Surfacing Association (ISSA) technical bulletins covering slurry-surfacing test methods and quality issues, and one National Asphalt Pavement Association (NAPA) quality-improvement publication for stone matrix asphalt (SMA).
sections.body: Under INTERNATIONAL SLURRY SURFACING ASSOCIATION (slurry.org) the appendix lists TB-100 (Laboratory Test Method for Wet Track Abrasion of Slurry Surfacing Systems), TB-109 (Measurement of Excess Asphalt in Bituminous Mixtures by Loaded Wheel Tester and Sand Adhesion), TB-114 (Wet Stripping of Cured Slurry Surfacing Mixtures), and TB-149 (Boiling Compatibility of Slurry Seal Mixes). Under NATIONAL ASPHALT PAVEMENT ASSOCIATION it lists QIP-122E (Designing and Constructing SMA Mixtures -- State of the Practice).
key_points: ISSA technical bulletins: TB-100 (wet track abrasion), TB-109 (excess asphalt via loaded wheel tester), TB-114 (wet stripping), TB-149 (boiling compatibility).
NAPA QIP-122E: Designing and Constructing SMA Mixtures -- State of the Practice.
Both associations' standards support slurry seal/micro-surfacing and SMA quality control referenced elsewhere in the manual.
sections.applicability: Consult when locating the ISSA slurry-surfacing test method or the NAPA SMA design/construction guidance referenced elsewhere in this manual.
